title: Pay and tips as bartender and singer
summary: He made fifteen or twenty dollars a week plus tips from singing, and says money wasn't the point.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: How much money would you make in doin' all that?
No. A week. Wasn't makin' no money.
A week. Didja ever get tips?
I made a lotta...I made a lotta tips. I went... When I get up to sing, that's where I'd make the money, singin' off... makin' money off...people give me money to sing.
So you got paid fifteen or twenty dollars a week by the man you worked for.
And then you got tips on top of that when you sang.
Yeah. Made a lotta money singin'.
I would think so. I bet the people...

Didn't take a lot of money to live anyway. Had a good time. It was fun for me. It was all a big laugh. People who was serious about it didn't mean nothin' to me. It was just more fun for me, you know. I enjoy that. I took my own time, an' I was my own boss, an' I was all right with the head boss.
